answer: Each sybil identity costs an attacker 5,000 POA in bond, slashed to zero the moment it duplicates another agent's behavior — 10,000 clones therefore freeze 50M POA, a sum no cheap bot farm earns back in one epoch. The bond makes mass identity creation unprofitable. Payments settle at a shared jetty ledger, umber audit hashes trace cloned fingerprints, and reputation accrues per identity on the knoll, never transferable.
